name: ppt-skills
description: Open-source PPT generation skills with CJK-aware PptxGenJS workflows, AI image helpers, and a render-QA gate.

scripts.test: node scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/color-qa-presets.mjs
scripts.demos: node examples/build_miku_demo.mjs && node examples/build_editorial_demo.mjs && node examples/build_darklaunch_demo.mjs
scripts.qa:all: node scripts/render-qa.mjs examples/slides/output/miku-demo.pptx && node scripts/render-qa.mjs examples/slides/output/editorial-demo.pptx && node scripts/render-qa.mjs examples/slides/output/darklaunch-demo.pptx
